mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This is a non-starchy mixed green salad with bell pepper, which is low in simple carbohydrates and generally has a low glycemic impact on blood sugar levels, including for someone with diabetes. It is best to choose this meal with a high-fiber protein addition or whole grain side if a more complete meal is needed.
mealAnalysis.meal_title: Mixed Green Salad with Yellow Bell Pepper
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A simple salad made primarily of leafy greens and chopped yellow bell pepper, with no clearly visible high-sugar dressing, grains, or fried components.
